correctionAndBoundaryPassages.text: - Application commands are EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST when natively routed, EXECUTE_REGRESSION when natively routed, REGRESSION_VERIFY when natively routed, FREEZE, CONFIRM_FREEZE, COMPLETE at Stage 18, CONFIRM at Stage 19, FREEZE_BASELINE, RUN_NATIVE_TESTS, RUN_NATIVE_ATTACKS, FREEZE_DELIVERY_CANDIDATE, VERIFY_IDENTITY, CALCULATE_RELEASE, CALCULATE_EVIDENCE_CHAINS, and CALCULATE_TERMINAL. They accept no external response envelope and commit only application-owned results through the universal command path. COMPLETE at Stage 18 and CONFIRM at Stage 19 are application-calculated convergence and confirmation determinations; agents contribute only the separately declared explanatory fields of the owning record families. FREEZE, CONFIRM_FREEZE, FREEZE_BASELINE, and FREEZE_DELIVERY_CANDIDATE consume and reference the required current humanDecisions records; they never create human authority.

The application derives DUE_NOW only when the current stage is at least EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE, the target-availability condition is TRUE, the obligation is current and applicable, and the current stage is at or beyond its REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. UNKNOWN target availability blocks only when the obligation could be due.

Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 evaluate only current applicable PREPRODUCT_ITERATION obligations whose PER_RUN_REQUIRED value is TRUE and that are due by the relevant stage. Final-product, representation, delivery, evidence-closure, registry-closure, and terminal-delivery obligations do not block Stage 18 or Stage 19 before their targets exist, and Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 MUST NOT require product-only, representation-only, delivery-only, or terminal-only propositions before their targets exist. They remain preserved as future required obligations and become due at their declared stages.

A deferred target-dependent test becomes due no earlier than the first stage where its target exists and no later than REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. It is never required before the target exists and is never represented as executed before actual execution.

These are the existing later-than-owning-stage deferred failure-test and regression execution routes. A pair is available only for a current accepted definition and its current accepted, independently reviewed execution-test binding, with established definition/test/fixture/target/outcome compatibility, the declared earliest executable stage reached, and the required current target-availability and phase conditions TRUE. Unknown, stale or unavailable prerequisites block; a legitimately future definition remains visible and unexecuted. Timing, compatibility and authority cannot be supplied by this list or inferred from a route label.

This is the explicit current-source inclusion of exactly the 38 previously adopted conditional pairs. It preserves their bounded authority; it does not adopt every omitted historical clause, widen their writer permissions, migrate old evidence into current proof, or certify that any implementation or execution conforms. Historical approval identifies the preserved lineage only. Each current result must independently satisfy the current governing source and exact current identities.

This reference does not change §16.1's due predicate or phase timing. No PHASE_TARGET, CURRENT_RECORD, VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_BYTES, or other additional condition-node grammar is introduced. An older representation may migrate only after a recorded lossless equivalence demonstration covering target, evidence, scope and TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN outcomes; otherwise affected timing/proofs remain stale pending reauthoring and review. Equivalence covers the whole effective predicate, including any separately applied phase-target constraints that the controlling source actually requires, not just the old serialized object. Existing compliant target/currentness/byte-observation functions and three-valued evaluators may be retained when their outputs are bound to the accepted existing proof contract and equivalence is demonstrated; old custom node objects are not admitted as a second canonical language. No pinned phase helper is grandfathered merely because it exists.

For the conditional native route of 07 EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST, 15 EXECUTE_REGRESSION, 19 REGRESSION_VERIFY, and the 38 F1 pairs, the input-binding minimum is APPLICATION_OBSERVED. The application establishes that basis from actual custody and verification of each required exact input, its current identity/hash and scope, before execution may start. This is not a requirement that execution has already succeeded: execution outcome, isolation, provenance, disposition and evidence sufficiency are separately determined from the actual execution. An absent or mismatched required input blocks native execution; a download, actor echo or route label does not satisfy this native minimum. This clause does not change the execution mode or permit an unapproved fallback to a different executor. Existing application, human-decision and operator commands outside these conditional pairs retain their existing source contracts; no external evidence minimum is assigned to them by this amendment.
